messages:
rachel_dx: quick sync - customers keep tripping over fetch behavior when bundling our JS SDK into edge functions. want a minimal recommendation we can paste in onboarding.

dmitri_eng: summary from infra: prefer native global fetch when its a full WHATWG impl, otherwise lazy-load undici in Node. main pain is bundlers inlining undici or test runners stubbing fetch.

jules_qa: test failures we saw: streaming uploads failing retries in prod because jsdom provided a non-cloneable fake fetch. we should add a guard in tests to simulate cloneable vs non-cloneable bodies.

rachel_dx: proposal: add an isCompatibleFetch() probe + FetchAdapter interface. document bundler externals for undici and provide a tiny error message that tells integrators how to fix common mistakes.

dmitri_eng: on typings: public d.ts should use DOM types (RequestInfo/RequestInit/Response) and never re-export undici types. for internal adapters we can keep narrow internal types.

jules_qa: +1. QA will add matrix jobs for node16,node18,jsdom and a miniflare worker smoke test.

deploy-bot: CI updated: added runtime-compat job. jobs queued.

rachel_dx: I'll draft a quick README section and a small example showing how to pass a custom fetch to the client for special cases. will also add a checklist for tsconfig (dom) and bundler externals.
